timeline.text: An explainer video about a mutation or timeline used to show whatever generic icon was on hand — not the real thing.
Now every picture can point straight at a real emoji instead of a guess.
For genetics, a DNA effect zooms into the exact base pair that changed.
Timelines now space dates by how far apart the years really are.
The whole set is licensed and verified: 1,595 Fluent Emoji images, pinned in place.
